input: Where in the Iris docs is the OTel export configured, and what env var turns it on?
output: Set IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT to an OTLP/HTTP collector base URL; src/otel/exporter.ts reads it at line 111 and, when it is set, every log_trace call and every POST /api/v1/traces ingest also fires a best-effort async export to $IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT/v1/traces. Optional companions are IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME for the service name and IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS for backend auth headers. The full write-up, the supported-backend table and the failure behaviour are in docs/otel-export.md.
